;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[Kurdish–Turkish conflict (2015–present)]], [[Northern Syria Buffer Zone]]
**Following a phone call between [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]], the [[White House]] says that [[Turkish Armed Forces]] will launch an incursion into [[Syrian Democratic Forces]]-held northern [[Syria]], and that [[United States Armed Forces]] will be withdrawing from the region to avoid clashing with its [[NATO]] ally. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/07/us-to-let-turkish-forces-move-into-syria-abandoning-kurdish-allies (''The Guardian'')]

;Law and crime
*[[List of mass shootings in the United States in 2019]]
**Police in [[Kansas City, Kansas]], are seeking two unnamed suspects after two men [[mass shootings in the United States|opened fire]] at a bar, killing four people and wounding another five. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-49951720 (BBC News)]
*[[Crime in Austria]]
**An [[Austrians|Austrian]] man kills five people in the town of [[Kitzbühel]], [[Tyrol (state)|Tyrol]]: his ex-girlfriend, her brother and parents, as well as her new boyfriend. He gives himself up at the police station. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-austria-crime/five-murdered-in-austrian-ski-town-of-kitzbuehel-police-idUSKCN1WL07L (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*The [[Jordan|Jordanian]] [[Cabinet of Jordan|government]] announces it has struck a deal with the teachers' union to end a month-long strike that affected at least 1.5 million students. The strike was instigated over pay in light of new [[austerity]] measures. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-jordan-strike-teachers/jordan-reaches-deal-with-teachers-union-to-end-one-month-strike-idUSKCN1WK0KQ?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Kosovan parliamentary election]]
**Following the resignation of [[Prime Minister of Kosovo|Prime Minister]] [[Ramush Haradinaj]] in July, voters in [[Kosovo]] cast their ballots to elect the new members of the [[Assembly of the Republic of Kosovo]]. Opposition party, [[Vetëvendosje]], led by [[Albin Kurti]] wins in an unprecedented victory. [https://www.dw.com/en/kosovo-votes-for-parliament-amid-calls-for-talks-with-serbia/a-50713649 (DW)]
*[[2019 Portuguese legislative election]]
**[[Portugal|Portuguese]] voters head to the polls to elect a new session to the [[Assembly of the Republic (Portugal)|Assembly of the Republic]]. In line with [[Opinion polling for the 2019 Portuguese legislative election|opinion polls]], exit polls show the incumbent [[Socialist Party (Portugal)|Socialist Party]] winning the most seats, but likely not quite enough to form a majority. [https://www.euronews.com/2019/10/05/portugal-elections-who-are-the-main-parties (euronews)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-portugal-election-socialist/portugals-socialists-claim-election-victory-idUSKBN1WL0I6 (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Tunisian parliamentary election]]
**[[Tunisia]]n citizens gather to vote in the country's latest parliamentary election. [https://www.dw.com/en/tunisia-election-a-chance-for-political-newcomers/a-50711837 (DW)]

;Science and technology
*[[Fermi bubbles]]
**Scientists say that, using data from the [[Hubble Space Telescope]], they have found evidence of a 300,000-year-long [[Seyfert flare|burst of radiation]] originating 3.5 million years ago from or near [[Sagittarius A*|the center of our galaxy]], erupting through both [[galactic pole]]s, with effects on the [[Magellanic Stream]], 200,000 light-years away. [https://earthsky.org/space/explosion-milky-way-center-seyfert-flare-magellanic-stream (EarthSky)]
